question: Should OpenClaw make Feishu contact-identifier redaction unconditional at the plugin outbound boundary to avoid Feishu audit rejections?
rationale: The code path looks correct, but the permanent behavior rewrites user-visible Feishu content and tests cannot decide whether that product tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Accept Feishu-local redaction policy
options.body: Merge as-is and own that Feishu delivery may replace contact-like text with placeholders to keep audited sends from failing.

options.title: Require a gated policy
options.body: Ask for an owner-approved opt-in or narrower rule if delivered-content fidelity must remain the default for Feishu users.

options.title: Pause for Feishu owner review
options.body: Keep the PR open until the declared Feishu owner or recent area owner confirms the desired content-rewriting policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Feishu-local redaction policy
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and own that Feishu delivery may replace contact-like text with placeholders to keep audited sends from failing.

likelyOwner.reason: The package and docs declare this handle as the Feishu plugin community owner, making them the best available owner for a Feishu-specific delivery policy choice.
